thread:
maria: Heads up — after merging PR #4021 (model-onboard) we see a p99 token latency spike on Dedicated pools for new-checkpoint-2. Seems correlated with router choosing single-GPU path and allocator thrashing :confused:

alex: ugh. observed in staging or prod? any CI signals? :eyes:

maria: staging first, then perf CI flagged it: ci-bot reported p95 +18% on seq_len=512 perf tests. stack traces show heavy CPU during kernel selection.

ci-bot: perf-ci/latency: job 2026-03-16-19 failed — p95 +18%, p99 +34% vs baseline. See: https://ci.internal/reports/2026-03-16/2026-03-16-19

kevin: can you paste the routing config that was deployed with the merge? may be heuristic change.

maria: here — the patch tightened latency_target and added a new heuristic 'prefer_local_kv' 
```
route_policy {
  latency_target_ms: 50
  prefer_local_kv: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
}
```

sam: prefer_local_kv looks suspicious — if it forces same-GPU single-shard routing it can severely limit batching. allocator sees many small allocations and thrashes.

alex: i pulled a profile from the staging job: flamegraph shows 40% spent in select_kernel_for_request and 25% in allocator.lock_wait. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-temp/3f2b7a9c8d1

maria: logs attached from one runner: 
```
[2026-03-16T19:02:12Z] route decision: local_kv=true -> assign gpu-7 (shard 0)
[2026-03-16T19:02:12Z] enqueue batch tokens=128
[2026-03-16T19:02:12Z] allocator: requested 64MB, GRACE_WAIT -> blocked
[2026-03-16T19:02:12Z] select_kernel: chosen kernel=quant_fp16_nhwc_v2
[2026-03-16T19:02:12Z] eviction: kv-cache miss, warming -> io wait
```

kevin: sounds like a chain: prefer_local_kv -> narrow routing -> small batches -> kernel-selection overhead increases -> allocator lock contention -> IO/warmup gaps -> p99 spike.

sam: quick repro: run bench-driver with --route=prefer_local_kv and seq_len=512. I can reproduce p99 spike locally.

maria: rolling back PR #4021 from staging now. will push a patch to make prefer_local_kv opt-in via onboarding metadata.

alex: also add a CI regression test that runs perf profile with seq_len=512 and route permutations. maybe gate if p99 increases >10%.

kevin: assigning followups: @sam add repro script + perf test (ticket INF-2894), @alex add changelog + test, @maria coordinate rollback and new patch.

maria: rollback complete on staging, p99 back to baseline. creating INF-2894 with notes and flamegraph links. will schedule deeper alloc profiler next week. :thumbsup:
